_comment: This is the only file you need to edit. See README.md for full instructions.
_departement_comment: Your département code (2 digits). Examples: 75=Paris, 77=Seine-et-Marne, 92=Hauts-de-Seine, 93=Seine-Saint-Denis, 94=Val-de-Marne, 69=Rhône/Lyon, 13=Bouches-du-Rhône/Marseille, 31=Haute-Garonne/Toulouse, 59=Nord/Lille. You can find your code at: https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liste_des_d%C3%A9partements_fran%C3%A7ais
_demarche_id_comment: The demarche (appointment type) number from the URL on rdv-prefecture.interieur.gouv.fr. To find yours: go to your prefecture's booking page and look at the number in the URL, e.g. rdv-prefecture.interieur.gouv.fr/rdvpref/reservation/demarche/XXXX. Common demarche IDs by procedure (these vary by département — always verify on the official site): Renouvellement titre de séjour: typically 3987-5500 range; Retrait titre de séjour (first request): typically 4000-5500 range; Retrait titre de séjour (renewal): typically 4293-5500 range. The easiest way: visit https://www.rdv-prefecture.interieur.gouv.fr, navigate to your department and procedure, and copy the number from the URL.
_subscribers_comment: List of email addresses that will receive notifications when slots open up. You can add multiple addresses: ["email1@example.com", "email2@example.com"]
